method: Five balanced pairs, warm local filesystem, loopback isolated OpenSSH with explicit generated Ed25519 identity, pinned strict known_hosts, no agent, fixed curve25519-sha256 / ssh-ed25519 / aes128-ctr / hmac-sha2-256, no compression; ready includes auth and SFTP v3 initialization; 500ms idle; list 512 UTF-8 filenames, then 16MiB generated binary upload to exclusive temporary file, fstat, fsync, close ACK, v3 no-clobber rename; download byte comparison plus before/after fstat, EOF, close; remove explicit test target. Real congminal Rust codec/client/model/transfer vs C libssh2 SFTP API with real congminal Rust NativePool callbacks and shared Budget (8MiB live, 1MiB single allocation, realloc reserves old+new overlap). Crypto library allocations are outside these callbacks. Standalone prototypes, not UI or Rust ssh2 crate. Parent/ssh client RSS sums may double-count shared mappings; server sampled separately. Cancellation/weak network/30min not benchmarked here.
sampler: libproc 每 5 ms；Mach 时间基准 125/3；进程树最多 64 项
